dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (OpenCOBOL) — uses GnuCOBOL-specific extensions: SET ENVIRONMENT for COB_SCREEN_EXCEPTIONS/COB_SCREEN_ESC, ACCEPT FROM ARGUMENT-NUMBER/ARGUMENT-VALUE, C$COPY intrinsic call, CRT STATUS, SCREEN SECTION with background-color/foreground-color, and 88-level WHEN SET TO FALSE syntax
evidence: 88 AddAttendeeFlagOn value 1 when set to false is 0

purpose.domain_detail: BarnCamp (outdoor camping/unconference event) attendee management system
purpose.summary: BAMS (BarnCamp Attendee Management System) manages attendee records for a camping event. It provides a terminal-based UI with screens to view, add, and edit attendee records stored in an indexed file, tracking arrival status, payment, dietary requirements, and kids. It also computes and displays statistics about people on-site, arriving, and staying till Monday.

notable_features: SCREEN SECTION with full TUI (background-color, foreground-color, highlight, reverse-video, underline)
Indexed file I/O with dynamic access mode
COPY statements for data definitions (DD-Attendee, DD-ScreenHeader, DD-Operation)
CALL to external subprograms: C$COPY (GnuCOBOL file copy), ListAttendeesScreen, createAuthCode
SET ENVIRONMENT for GnuCOBOL screen exception handling
ACCEPT FROM ARGUMENT-NUMBER / ARGUMENT-VALUE for CLI argument processing
88-level condition names with WHEN SET TO FALSE
CLASS condition HexNumber defined in SPECIAL-NAMES
verdict.notes: No SQL or CICS. The program is a real-world event management tool for 'BarnCamp', likely an unconference. GnuCOBOL dialect is confirmed by multiple vendor-specific features. COBOL-85 base standard with GnuCOBOL extensions. Fixed format but some lines exceed column 72 (32 long lines), likely due to screen section value strings.
